title: Equity Analysis Toolkit: A Worked Example

fields.label: The decision and its limits
fields.fieldResponse: Revise the CFSS explanation, format, and route to help so readers can identify their next step. Confirm current guidance and decision authority. Eligibility rules are outside this notice revision.
fields.reasoning: An intention does not identify a decision. Scope, open choices, authority and requirements make the proposal examinable.

fields.label: People, evidence, and unanswered questions
fields.fieldResponse: Ask about language and disability access, shared devices, and assistance. Review available questions and usability evidence. Seek missing perspectives directly; needs have not yet been established.
fields.reasoning: A universal claim can conceal unequal burdens. These are questions to investigate, not findings about CFSS participants or inferred group preferences.

fields.label: Options and tradeoffs
fields.fieldResponse: Compare the current notice, a revised paper explanation, and accessible formats with a supported help route. Paper reduces internet dependence but does not meet every access need. Multiple formats require review, staff time, and ongoing updates. Test proposed adjustments with affected people.
fields.reasoning: A single action is not an alternatives analysis. Compare benefits, burdens, mitigation and uncertainty, including the current approach.

fields.label: Participation and next actions
fields.fieldResponse: Invite service users while wording, formats, and the help route remain open. Plan language, disability access and scheduling supports. A communications lead will coordinate review and report back on changes and reasons. Confirm authority and resources; one participant or meeting cannot establish community agreement.
fields.reasoning: Participation must have influence before choices are settled, with support, responsibility and a report-back commitment.

fields.label: Review responsibilities and reconsideration
fields.fieldResponse: Ask readers to describe their next step. Review unanswered questions, assistance requests and people not reached. Assign someone to follow up and agree a review date. Repeated confusion about the help route prompts reconsideration. Assign an owner and resources to update every format when guidance changes.
fields.reasoning: Distribution is not comprehension or access. Specify useful signals, limits, responsibility, a review point and a reconsideration trigger; plan maintenance.
